mechanics.claim: The Anti-Magic Bulwark shield only regenerates while Galio takes no damage for a period; it does not passively regenerate mid-fight.
mechanics.quote: restores it after {{pp|12 to 8 for 3|1;6;11}} seconds without taking damage

mechanics.claim: Charging the ability increases the recast's radius, damage and taunt duration only during the first 1.25 seconds of the channel, even though the channel itself lasts up to 2 seconds.
mechanics.quote: charging increases ''Shield of Durand's'' radius, damage and {{tip|taunt}} duration over the first {{fd|1.25}} seconds of the channel

mechanics.claim: The ability automatically recasts when the channel duration ends or is interrupted, dealing the recast damage and reapplying the damage reduction.
mechanics.quote: can be recast within the duration and does so automatically afterwards or if it is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}

mechanics.claim: After the recast (automatic or manual), Galio cannot basic attack or cast for 0.4 seconds, delaying his next damage instance.
mechanics.quote: '''''Galio''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to basic attack or cast abilities for {{fd|0.4}} seconds after the recast.''

mechanics.claim: The recast deals magic damage to nearby enemy champions only, not to non-champions in a dummy sense; the damage is a single instance scaled by charge time.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemy champions, increased by {{pp|type=channel time|key=%|0 to 200 for 9|0 to 1.25|formula=100%+(25% per 0.16 seconds channeled).}}

mechanics.claim: The active grants physical and magic damage reduction and self-slow while channeling, both of which end when the channel ends unless refreshed by the recast.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|channel|charges}} for up to 2 seconds, {{tip|slow|slowing}} himself by 15%, and gaining {{as|physical|physical damage}} and {{as|magic|magic damage}} damage reduction
